6.252 rsInvalidTablixCellRowSpan
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidTablixCellRowSpan is a critical error that will occur when a TablixCell.CellContents element
has CellContents.RowSpan set to a value other than 1.
